$comment: Golden settlement vectors — PRD §19 V1–V22, revised 2026-10-05 for the 70/30 forfeit split and no carry-over, and 2026-10-09 for the 70/5/5/10/10 re-split and the 20% comeback refund, 2026-10-10 for the 10% boost cap, and 2026-10-12 for the 70/10/10/10 split, the guaranteed comeback pledge of the next round and no-finisher pools to the boost reserve. The contract must reproduce these exactly (constitution VII: these exist as failing tests before the logic). Amounts are whole SKR base units.

rules.fee: fee = floor(forfeited * 30 / 100), taken at forfeit time
rules.share_per_tier: share_t = floor(pool * chip_t / total_finisher_stake) — constant time per tier (research R10)
rules.remainder: remainder = pool - sum over tiers of (finisher_count_t * share_t); sent to the fee destination at settlement (FR-032a)
rules.no_finishers: to_boost = pool: the whole pool goes to the league's boost reserve; the developer and operations took their parts at forfeit time (FR-037, 2026-10-12)
rules.forfeit_split: per forfeited stake s: fee = floor(30% s); comeback = floor(10% s), pledged to the forfeiting member; developer = floor(10% s); operations = fee - comeback - developer; pool = s - fee (FR-027, H35, 2026-10-12)
rules.boost: boost = min(floor(10% of the cohort's own pool), league boost reserve), drawn at finalization before shares (FR-037d; cap 10% since 2026-10-10, was 20%)
rules.comeback: owed = min(floor(10% of the counted forfeited stake), the new stake), for finishing the comeback round only; funded = total owed, always, because every owed refund is pledged in the comeback reserve; refund = floor(entitled * funded / total owed) (FR-037e)
rules.comeback_round: first = smallest k with first_start + k * cadence > missed_at; last = first while first is open to join the second after the miss (missed_at + 1 < first_start + first * cadence - join_lock), else first + 1. Finishing any round from first to last makes the comeback good; the member may join round first late, until its first day's deadline (FR-037e)
